scripts.build:libs: npm run build:ui && npm run build:core
scripts.build:web: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace=@lfps/web
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:web && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', '.', { recursive: true });"
scripts.test: node scripts/version.mjs check && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
